svg.title: Reciprocation trajectories: Dood, Leven, Zweven
svg.desc: Three panels of one Relatie’s gap, ΔE = E_ij − E_ji, the difference between what each side holds of the other, over a stretch of its life (Sections IX.2 and XX of the Speelgoed). The gap closes toward the difference of the two Bindingen, û_j − û_i, drawn as faint steps, and moves only as those Bindingen move. Its Helling λ = −ΔĖ / ΔE is the rate at which it closes toward parity, ΔE = 0. Dood: the Bindingen come to rest apart; the gap closes toward their difference and stops short of parity, and λ falls toward zero. Leven: a Vonk reorders the two Bindingen; the gap runs through parity without slowing toward the new difference, and the Partners swap which carries the Eigen and which the Echo. Zweven: the Bindingen keep moving, crossing by crossing; the gap keeps moving, never settled and never flipped. Each switch between trajectories is a crossing of the Relatie itself and fires a Vonk. The curves are shapes; no scale is implied.
svg.text: §IX.2 · §XX · THE GAP OF ONE RELATIE, OVER ITS LIFE
the gap stops short of parity,
The gap closes toward the difference of the two Bindingen (faint steps) and moves only as they move:
as a pole is read, as a Trouw moves at its Vonken, or as a Leeg shifts.
Each switch is a crossing of the Relatie itself, and fires a Vonk: Ontwaking, Herrijzenis, Bezinking,
Verkwisting, Ontdooiing, Verstijving. Out of Dood, only a crossing of another Relatie of one of its Leden moves it.
An Echo has a rate, not a fixed size, and that rate is what the three names track. The shapes carry no scale.
